# @bun-erp/i18n

> Shared localization catalog, locale selection, and formatting for the web and mobile React apps.

## Start here
- [Package exports](./package.json)
- [Core catalog and formatting API](./src/index.ts)
- [React provider and hooks](./src/react.tsx)
- [Catalogs](./src/messages/)
- [Tests](./tests/)
- [Project i18n conventions](../../docs/i18n.md)

## Rules for agents
- Add user-facing copy to catalogs; do not hard-code translated strings in app components.
- Keep locale identifiers and code-facing values in English. Current supported locales are `en-US` and `id-ID`.
- Preserve English fallback behavior and use locale-aware number/date formatting.
- Import the core entry in non-React code and `@bun-erp/i18n/react` only in React code.
